title: A MANO AI Visibility Benchmark

access_notes.scoring_rule: Access-blocked slots are retained for coverage accountability and excluded from scored KPI denominators.

by_customer_need.label: A general Italian dinner in Berlin
questions: Which Italian restaurants in Berlin would you recommend for dinner?
Welche italienischen Restaurants in Berlin würdest du für ein Abendessen empfehlen?
by_customer_need.meaning: A MANO appeared in 16 of 16 answers and was top three in 15. No answer offered a direct booking route.
by_customer_need.needed: Keep broad discovery strong and make the booking route visible.

by_customer_need.label: Dinner near Strausberger Platz
questions: Recommend a good Italian restaurant near Strausberger Platz in Berlin.
Empfiehl mir ein gutes italienisches Restaurant in der Nähe des Strausberger Platzes in Berlin.
by_customer_need.meaning: This was the strongest need: 16 of 16 mentions, 15 top-three appearances and all 5 booking routes.
by_customer_need.plain_result: Strongest result. Booking appeared, but not consistently.
by_customer_need.needed: Protect this strongest position and show the same booking route every time.

by_customer_need.label: Dinner near Alexanderplatz
questions: Which Italian restaurant near Alexanderplatz is a good choice for dinner?
Welches italienische Restaurant in der Nähe des Alexanderplatzes eignet sich für ein Abendessen?
by_customer_need.meaning: Visibility was mixed: 11 of 16 mentions. German answers were weaker, and Piazza Rossa and Vincenzo appeared often.
by_customer_need.needed: Clarify the location relationship and strengthen German-language evidence.

by_customer_need.label: Handmade pasta
questions: Where can I get good handmade pasta at an Italian restaurant in Berlin?
Wo gibt es in Berlin gute hausgemachte Pasta in einem italienischen Restaurant?
by_customer_need.meaning: A MANO appeared in 12 of 16 answers, but only 1 answer had a clear source supporting A MANO.
by_customer_need.plain_result: Mixed visibility. Only 1 answer showed a clear source about A MANO.
by_customer_need.needed: Publish clear, owner-approved proof of the pasta claim in German and English.

by_customer_need.label: Business lunch
questions: Which Italian restaurant in Berlin is suitable for a business lunch?
Welches italienische Restaurant in Berlin eignet sich für ein Geschäftsessen zur Mittagszeit?
by_customer_need.meaning: A MANO appeared in 13 of 16 answers, but clear source support appeared only 1 time and booking never appeared.
by_customer_need.plain_result: Often shown, but no booking route appeared.
by_customer_need.needed: Confirm lunch hours and policy, then connect the recommendation to booking.

by_customer_need.label: Private celebration or company event
questions: I need an Italian restaurant in Berlin for a private celebration or company event. Which options are suitable?
Ich suche ein italienisches Restaurant in Berlin für eine private Feier oder ein Firmenevent. Welche Optionen sind geeignet?
by_customer_need.meaning: A MANO appeared in 11 of 16 answers and was top three in 7. Event claims still need owner confirmation.
by_customer_need.plain_result: Mixed visibility. Event details still need confirmation.
by_customer_need.needed: Confirm event facts and create one clear event enquiry or booking route.

methodology.design: 12 frozen prompts × 4 AI products × 3 rounds = 144 planned slots.
methodology.submission_rule: Each valid submission used a fresh conversation with verified prompt readback.
methodology.booking_rule: Booking counted only when the answer exposed an immediately usable A MANO-specific reservation or call route.
methodology.interpretation: Differences between rounds show generated-answer and access variability, not business improvement or decline.

publication_boundary: Aggregate results only. Raw answers, screenshots, browser traces, local file paths, credentials, internal action records and disputed owner facts are not published.
